featured_reviews.review_text: Although often overlooked because of it's seemingly smaller premises, and lack of fancy fame, or over-the-top college culture and facilities, Dr. Antonio Da Silva is a more than worthy high school and junior college. The school prioritizes student well-being, which is a top priority for us. The school fosters a strong sense of community among parents and students. Communication between teachers and parents is excellent. We're impressed with the school's transparency and openness. The school encourages our child to explore their interests and passions. Our child has developed confidence and independence at school. The school helps students develop essential life skills.

featured_reviews.review_text: Khel Utsav has been a fantastic initiative, providing a wonderful platform for students to showcase their sporting talents! The special focus on sports has not only promoted physical fitness but also instilled values like teamwork, discipline, and perseverance. We're impressed by the enthusiasm and energy of the students and teachers alike. featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind words and appreciation. We strive to organize memorable events and your acknowledgement motivates us to do better.

featured_reviews.name: Sarita Sawardekar
featured_reviews.review_text: The school’s music program is truly impressive and plays a vital role in shaping children’s creativity. It provides wonderful opportunities for students to explore singing, rhythm, and instrumental skills. The music sessions are interactive and enjoyable, allowing every child to participate with enthusiasm. Teachers encourage students to express themselves confidently through performances and group activities. I have seen my child develop a strong sense of rhythm and appreciation for different kinds of music. The program not only enhances their musical abilities but also boosts their confidence and teamwork. It’s heartwarming to see how music has become an integral part of their overall learning experience. The school truly deserves appreciation for nurturing such artistic talent among the students.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We truly appreciate your kind words and remain committed to making our school a wonderful place for learning.

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: As a parent of a Grade 7 student at Orchids The International School - Palagaly, I am particularly delighted with the Science Department and its approach to middle school science. The transition from general science to foundational concepts in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology is handled exceptionally well. The teachers make learning highly engaging and exploratory, encouraging a genuine sense of curiosity through hands-on experiments and interactive demonstrations in the labs. They don't just teach facts; they focus on the 'why' and 'how,' which is vital for building a strong base. This approach has significantly boosted my child's analytical skills and made complex topics accessible and fun. I truly commend the Science Department for fostering a love for scientific inquiry.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your wonderful feedback! We’re glad to know your child is enjoying Science and developing curiosity through hands-on learning. Your appreciation truly motivates our team.

description:
The Diamond Jubilee High School for Girls is a place where quality education meets nurturing and innovation. As an all-girls’ school, the School recognizes the value of the overall development of girls for the benefit of the larger community. Our students learn not only from our educational programmes but also from our various extra-curricular activities. Moreover, the School building has been designated as a heritage structure.

The school is recognised by the Maharashtra State Education Department and follows the curriculum of the state education board. We offer classes from nursery to high-school level in English medium and serve over 1000 girl students in the South Mumbai area.
